parameters.query:
SELECT j.title, j.company, j.url, j.location, j.source,
       m.score, m.summary, m.requirements_gap,
       a.status, a.submitted_at, a.cover_letter, a.error
  FROM applications a
  JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
  LEFT JOIN match_results m ON m.job_id = j.id
 WHERE a.job_id = $1;
